title: Restore Ride request QR in Pulse Drive Mode Inbox
acceptanceCriteria: Inbox visibly exposes Ride request QR.
QR overlay renders the rider request QR URL.
Open form and Share link are available.
Canonical QR/form URLs fail closed unless BOTH Request App URL and token are configured.
Canonical source contains no isolated staging URL override.
The isolated Request App retains its explicit mode=test no-write path for staging smoke testing.
PULSE-079 mid-ride request hold behavior remains intact.
No automatic merge, production deployment, Engine A/B activation, or production data mutation.
